subject: Request: Executive approval for extended POC credits & timeline
thread_summary: Customer requests additional credits and 4-week POC extension due to expanded test cases. Sales requests executive sign-off for 200k token top-up and one-time extension; leadership approves conditional on PO and committed rollout timeline.
messages:
From: Emma Thomas <emma.thomas@mosaichealth.com>
To: soojin_lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-12T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mosaic POC - running out of credits and extended evaluation scope

Hi Soojin,

Quick update from our side — we've expanded the evaluation to include two additional production connectors and an anonymized subset of historical data. The expanded tests burned through the credits faster than we expected; our team is now at ~85% of the allotted trial units and we still have critical scenarios to validate.

Would Redwood consider a one-time top-up of credits (roughly 200k tokens) and an extra 4 weeks on the POC window? Procurement also needs a written note if there are any non-standard terms.

Thanks,
Emma Thomas
Director of Data & Integrations
Mosaic Health

---
Attachment: Mosaic_Usage_Report_July.pdf (pdf)
From: soojin_lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-12T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Mosaic POC - request for 200k top-up + 4wk extension (need exec ok)

Team,

Forwarding Emma's note — Mosaic is a strategic mid-market account (healthcare) that's evaluated positively so far. They've expanded scope which caused the overrun. Quick facts:
- Current trial consumption: ~85%
- Ask: 200k token top-up + 4-week POC extension
- Procurement wants a written statement on any non-standard terms
- We have a HubSpot record and SOW v2 attached

Recommended approach: approve a one-time credit top-up and the extension conditionally if they sign the attached SOW v2 and provide a PO for anticipated production purchase within 60 days of POC close. Finance flagged that credits >150k generally require leadership sign-off.

Can we get an executive OK? If approved, I'll confirm terms to Mosaic and loop in Procure/Legal for the short addendum.

Thanks,
Soojin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Subject: Re: Fwd: Mosaic POC - request for 200k top-up + 4wk extension (need exec ok)

Soojin —

I support approving the ask to preserve momentum. Quick cost math: 200k tokens at our marginal eval rate equates to a ~$2.6k variable credit (not list price), and the extension keeps the deal in motion which looks to be a near-term close. My suggestions:
- Approve 200k token one-time credit (no recurring discount)
- Require SOW v2 signed and PO receipt within extension window
- Add a clause: credits are non-transferable and expire at the end of the extended POC

Karthik — can finance/legal OK the wording? If yes, please advise if we need an approval ticket or if Laura can sign off with a brief note here.

Marissa
Senior Sales Manager, Growth Accounts
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Team —

I reviewed the ask and the attached usage report. Approve a one-time 200k token credit and the 4-week extension on these conditions:
1) Mosaic signs SOW v2 (attached) before the extension begins.
2) We receive a PO from Procurement indicating intent-to-purchase within 60 days after POC close, or a written roadmap to procurement timelines.
3) Credits expire at POC end and are non-transferable.

Karthik: please document this as a one-off approval in the deal record (RDW-2026-344) and flag Finance to treat this as a promotional credit (not discounting list price). Marissa/Soojin: confirm the exact date window in your reply so I can sign the note for Procurement.

Laura Bennett
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

Good news: leadership has approved a one-time 200k token credit and a 4-week POC extension. Conditions are the same as discussed:

- Provide a PO or procurement timeline indicating intent-to-purchase within 60 days after POC close.
- Credits will expire at the end of the extended POC and are non-transferable.

If you can confirm acceptance of these terms and the desired new POC end date by EOD Tuesday, we will apply the credit and extend the window. I will follow up with a short addendum for procurement and route to Legal for a one-page sign-off.

Thanks — excited to keep the momentum going.
